Hotel Equities Strengthens Leadership Team with Key Executive Appointments Across New Divisions 

### Hotel Equities Strengthens Leadership Team with Key Executive Appointments Across New Divisions 

 November 10, 2025 

Atlanta, GA – Hotel Equities (HE), a leading hospitality operator and developer, announces a series of strategic executive appointments across its Full Service, Focused Service, and Lifestyle divisions. These moves and additions will drive innovation, enhance performance, and help create lasting guest experiences across the portfolio—priorities for HE in generating long-term value for key owners and stakeholders.

“These executives bring exceptional talent and diverse industry experience to their newly created roles,” said Albert Smith, Chief Operating Officer of Hotel Equities. “Their leadership is integral as we continue to strengthen our lifestyle, full-, and select-service divisions across the U.S., Canada, and CALA, enhancing value for our owners and partners. By promoting from within, we’re investing in high performers who will help us grow our portfolio and expand our platform for innovation — from traditional hotels to new concepts like our leading outdoor hospitality brand, Postcard Cabins.”

Newly announced positions include:

Peter Tziahanas, President, Full Service Division

Peter Tziahanas joined Hotel Equities in 2021 and previously served as Executive Vice President of Operations, overseeing key lifestyle and owned assets across the firm’s portfolio. In his new role, he collaborates with internal and external stakeholders to drive operational excellence, profitability, and enhanced guest and employee engagement. Before joining HE, Peter held several multi-unit leadership positions with prominent management groups, including Pivot Hotels at Davidson Hospitality Group, where he successfully led the lifestyle operating vertical.

David Rosenberg, President, Focused Service Division

David Rosenberg joined Hotel Equities in 2020 and most recently served as Executive Vice President of Operations, where he oversaw the deployment of analytics-driven performance dashboards, managed M&A integrations, and led a substantial portion of HE’s multi-branded hotel portfolio. He also guided the company’s entry into the outdoor hospitality segment through the integration of Postcard Cabins into the portfolio. With extensive experience across both full-service and select-service hotels, David has held several executive roles throughout his career, consistently driving revenue growth, market share, profitability, and team engagement.

Becky Vealey, Senior Vice President of Sales, Full Service & Lifestyle Division

Becky Vealey, previously HE’s Vice President of Revenue Generation, now oversees sales strategies for the Full Service and Lifestyle Division. Becky leads a high-performing team of Revenue Managers, Corporate Directors of Sales, and Marketing Executives, driving revenue across a multi-brand portfolio. With over a decade in above-property roles and hands-on experience at the property level, Becky brings a strategic and operational edge in revenue generation and commercial leadership. She is also active in HE’s mentorship initiatives helping grow the next generation of leaders in the industry.

Carol Lobaito, Senior Vice President of Sales, Focused Service Division

Carol Lobaito, formerly Vice President of Sales & Marketing, now oversees strategic initiatives to grow market share, drive revenue, and enhance brand awareness within the Focused Service Division and across HE’s outdoor hospitality portfolio. With over 20 years of experience spanning property-level sales, multi-property oversight, and national brand leadership, Carol excels at collaborating with property teams, ownership groups, and franchise partners. 

Liz Flurry, Vice President of Growth Marketing

Liz Flurry, formerly Director of Marketing and Brand Activation, has been promoted to this new role, in which she develops and executes innovative digital marketing and e-commerce strategies to drive booking conversion across HE’s branded portfolio. Liz brings extensive experience in traditional and digital marketing, social media, reputation management, and brand development, including seven years with Marriott. 

Eve Tronson, Vice President of Marketing, Lifestyle Division 

Eve Tronson joins HE as VP of Marketing, overseeing brand, digital, CRM, and field marketing strategy across the portfolio of lifestyle and independent hotels. With over two decades of hospitality experience, including leadership roles at Viceroy Hotels & Resorts, Eve brings expertise in brand storytelling, performance marketing, e-commerce, and guest lifecycle strategy. She is recognized for her collaborative leadership, cross-functional approach, and data-informed creativity that drive measurable growth.

Brandon Standerfer, Vice President of Distribution, Lifestyle Division 

Brandon Standerfer, promoted to VP of Distribution, brings more than 20 years of experience in revenue management, distribution optimization, project management, call center operations, reservation sales, and process improvement. He has worked across all hotel segments, from economy to boutique lifestyle luxury, and is recognized for his ability to integrate diverse disciplines into cohesive, high-performing strategies that optimize revenue and operational efficiency.

Jennifer Cannistraci, Vice President of Sales, Lifestyle Division 

Jennifer Cannistraci, promoted to VP of Sales, leads strategic growth and brand success across a portfolio of lifestyle assets. With experience at Four Seasons, The Beverly Hilton, Sunset Marquis, and Hotel Amarano, Jennifer combines creativity with data-driven strategy to deliver measurable results and elevate brand presence. Her collaborative approach and business acumen position her to drive continued growth and success for the lifestyle portfolio.

To learn more about Hotel Equities’ leadership team, click here. Additional information about the company can be found at www.hotelequities.com or by following @Hotel-Equities. Career opportunities can be explored on the Hotel Equities Careers page at hotelequities.com/careers.htm.

Hotel Equities Announces Key Leadership Appointments After Strategic Merger With Springboard Hospitality 

### Hotel Equities Announces Key Leadership Appointments After Strategic Merger With Springboard Hospitality 

 July 02, 2025 

ATLANTA & HONOLULU – July 2, 2025 — As part of the strategic integration following the merger of Springboard Hospitality and Hotel Equities, the combined hospitality management company announces two key leadership appointments: Albert Smith as Chief Operating Officer of Hotel Equities and Rob Robinson as President of Springboard Hospitality. These executive placements mark a significant milestone in aligning leadership for the organization’s integration post-merger.

“These leadership appointments reflect our commitment to operational excellence and strategic expansion as we continue to unify our platform,” said Ben Rafter, Chief Executive Officer of Hotel Equities. “Rob’s leadership has been instrumental to Springboard’s evolution, and Al brings a proven track record in scaling high-performing hotel portfolios. Together, they will help shape the future of our organization and deliver value to our stakeholders.”

About Albert Smith

Based in Atlanta, Smith now leads enterprise-wide operations for Hotel Equities, with responsibility for optimizing performance across hotels, resorts, and outdoor hospitality destinations throughout the United States, Canada, the Caribbean, and Latin America.

Smith most recently served as President of Hotel Operations at Hotel Equities, where he oversaw the strategic management and growth of the company's hotel portfolio. Prior to joining HE, he was Senior Vice President of Lifestyle Hotels at Highgate, leading a portfolio of independent, full-service luxury hotels across the East Coast. Earlier in his career, Smith held senior roles at Pivot Hotels & Resorts for Davidson Hospitality, Viceroy Hotel Group, SBE Entertainment, and Kimpton Hotels & Restaurants, building a reputation for operational excellence, brand development, and strategic leadership.

With over 20 years of experience in upper-upscale and luxury hospitality, Smith brings a holistic understanding of hotel operations across a range of disciplines, including sales, marketing, revenue management, brand development and talent strategy. His appointment reinforces HE’s commitment to operational strength and scalable growth across all verticals.

About Rob Robinson

Based in Honolulu, Robinson now oversees all aspects of the Springboard Hospitality platform and portfolio, with a focus on driving financial performance, executing long-term growth strategies, fostering a strong company culture, and expanding the portfolio across high-growth markets. 

Previously executive vice president of Springboard Hospitality, Robinson originally joined OLS Hotels & Resorts in 2018 as part of its new ownership group and played a key role in the company’s transformation into Springboard. He led the company’s rebrand and spearheaded initiatives that positioned Springboard for national growth. 

Robinson’s career spans both the restaurant and hospitality industries, with leadership roles at Kimpton Hotels & Restaurants and Highgate, as well as experience as an entrepreneur, having owned and operated a group of successful restaurants and bars in the San Francisco Bay Area. He remains deeply engaged in both the industry and his local community, serving on the Executive Board of Directors for the Waikiki Improvement Association, the Board of the Hawaii Lodging and Tourism Association, and as Chairman of the Waikiki Beach Special Improvement District Association, which he helped found. He also serves on the Advisory Board for Kapiolani Community College’s hospitality program.

Hotel Equities Announces Key Executive Appointments Across Operations, Finance, and Marketing Teams 

### Hotel Equities Announces Key Executive Appointments Across Operations, Finance, and Marketing Teams 

 August 21, 2025 

Hotel Equities (HE), a best-in-class hospitality operator and developer, today announces a series of key executive appointments across its operations, finance, and marketing teams. These leadership placements add proven expertise in areas critical to its next phase, from elevating portfolio performance and strengthening international financial operations to enhancing marketing impact for owners and brand partners. Together, these hires position HE for sustained success across the United States, Canada, the Caribbean, and Latin America.

“These appointments reflect our focus on aligning top-tier leadership talent with our strategic priorities,” said Ben Rafter, Chief Executive Officer of Hotel Equities. “Each of these leaders brings a proven track record in their respective disciplines. Together, they will play a critical role in shaping our unified platform, enhancing the experience for every associate and guest.”

The following executives have recently stepped into new leadership roles at Hotel Equities:

Taylor Hall – Vice President of Operations

Hall oversees operations for a portfolio of properties in the Midwest U.S.. She most recently served as Vice President of Operations at Aperture Hotels, where she managed a multi-branded portfolio of Marriott, Hilton, and IHG properties. In that role, she consistently drove RevPAR growth, improved GOP margins, optimized labor efficiency, and elevated guest and associate satisfaction across her portfolio. With a strong background in rooms and food & beverage operations and strategic revenue management, Hall has successfully guided properties through brand transitions and operational improvements.

Mike Hrusovsky – Vice President of Operations

 Hrusovsky now leads operational strategy and performance for a multi-brand portfolio. With more than 37 years in hospitality leadership, he has directed operations for high-profile resorts and hotels in markets including Marco Island, San Antonio, and throughout Michigan. Hrusovsky is recognized for successfully navigating brand conversions and complex renovations while consistently delivering improvements in guest satisfaction. Prior to joining HE, he held senior operational roles at Hospitality Specialists, Inc., overseeing the performance of a portfolio of diverse hotels and played a key role in budgeting and strategic growth initiatives, earning a reputation for his ability to build strong teams and deliver sustainable results.

Martin Larralde – Vice President of Finance, Caribbean and Latin America (CALA)

Larralde oversees all financial operations for HE’s growing CALA region, partnering closely with regional ownership groups to ensure financial performance and long-term value creation. He previously served as Regional Director of Finance for Oak View Group in Mexico, where he implemented robust financial controls and enhanced reporting processes for major sports and entertainment venues. Earlier in his career, Larralde spent nine years with Hilton Worldwide, holding senior finance roles that included oversight of multi-country operations and pre-opening financial planning for flagship properties. A certified public accountant, he brings deep expertise in strategic compliance and capital planning.

Mike Sutter – Vice President of Operations

Sutter now leads operations for a portfolio of lifestyle and full-service hotels within HE. Bringing more than 25 years of hospitality experience, he has held leadership roles with Kimpton Hotels & Restaurants, Marriott International, and Solis Hotels & Resorts. Sutter has successfully guided high-performing teams through multiple hotel openings and ownership transitions, earning a well-deserved reputation for delivering strong financial performance while consistently enhancing guest satisfaction. His expertise spans strategic planning and operational execution across lifestyle and luxury segments. In his new role, Sutter will focus on aligning operational strategies with HE’s growth objectives and ensuring performance excellence across his portfolio.

Dana Wendell – Vice President of Marketing, Strategic Accounts

Wendell leads marketing strategy for HE’s strategic accounts portfolio, focusing on initiatives that strengthen brand positioning and elevate client relationships. She brings more than 20 years of experience shaping integrated marketing strategies for hospitality, wellness, residential, publishing, and retail brands. Wendell has worked with organizations including Miraval Resorts, Civana Wellness Resort & Spa, Omni Hotels & Resorts, and Teneo Hospitality Group, leading creative teams and executing campaigns that have driven double-digit market share growth.

These appointments demonstrate HE’s commitment to building a leadership team equipped to guide the company’s next chapter: one focused on strategic growth, operational excellence, and delivering exceptional value for owners, associates, and guests. For more information about Hotel Equities and its leadership, visit www.hotelequities.com/meet-our-team.htm.

Hotel Equities Appoints Brian Jenkins to Lead HE Labs, the Management Company’s New Innovation Division 

### Hotel Equities Appoints Brian Jenkins to Lead HE Labs, the Management Company’s New Innovation Division 

 May 29, 2026 

ATLANTA, Ga. — Hotel Equities (HE), a best-in-class hospitality operator, announces the appointment of Brian Jenkins as Head of HE Labs™, Hotel Equities' dedicated innovation and incubation platform built for evaluating emerging technologies, developing AI-driven workflows, and advancing new operating models designed to improve owner returns and hotel performance across the portfolio. In this role, Jenkins will oversee all HE Labs initiatives, from testing and evaluation to deployment, ensuring each advances through a defined progression before being implemented at the property-level and scaled.

"Brian's background sits at the intersection of strategy and hospitality operations, and that combination is precisely what this role demands,” said Ben Rafter, Chief Executive Officer of Hotel Equities. “The industry has never had a shortage of technologies; what it has lacked is the discipline to evaluate them rigorously, integrate them seamlessly, and deploy only those that move the needle. HE Labs exists to deliver validated solutions to owners, not experiments, and Brian brings the discipline, operating perspective, and analytical rigor required to lead that work."

"The gap between what technology promises and what it actually delivers for owners is where HE Labs operates,” said Jenkins. “This is the right moment for this kind of platform. Our focus is to bring discipline to that gap: evaluating what works, deploying what fits, and scaling solutions that improve performance.”

Before leading HE Labs, Jenkins served as Executive Vice President of Strategic Initiatives, shaping Hotel Equities' broader technology and innovation strategy, conducting business development, and applying quantitative analysis to operational decision-making, including the development of the Hospitality Intelligence (H.I.) platform, Springboard's proprietary system blending technology and human insight to enhance operational efficiency. Previously, Jenkins held a series of strategic roles at Springboard Hospitality, which he joined in 2016 ahead of its combination with Hotel Equities in 2025. 

Before entering hospitality, Jenkins was a strategy consultant at Capco in New York, where he advised leading financial institutions on IT strategy, organizational restructuring, change management, and risk management. He holds a B.A. in Financial Economics from Columbia University.

For more information about Hotel Equities and its leadership, visit www.hotelequities.com/meet-our-team.htm. To learn more about HE Labs™, visit www.hotelequities.com/he-labs.htm.

 4800 North Point Parkway, Suite 250 Alpharetta, GA 30022 United States info@hotelequities.com

Hotel Equities and Springboard Hospitality Announce Strategic Merger 

### Hotel Equities and Springboard Hospitality Announce Strategic Merger 

 May 06, 2025 

ATLANTA & HONOLULU — Hotel Equities and Springboard Hospitality today announced a strategic merger, effective May 1, creating a scaled and differentiated hotel management company built to deliver value for hotel owners across branded and independent segments. The merger brings together two complementary organizations with distinct strengths: Hotel Equities, known for its superior performance in branded, select- and full-service assets, and Springboard Hospitality, a leader in managing independent, lifestyle, and resort properties. The combined company will operate a broad portfolio of properties across the United States, Canada, the Caribbean, and Latin America spanning urban, resort and outdoor destinations. 

The newly merged entity will continue to operate as an owner-focused management company, offering tailored strategies backed by institutional-grade infrastructure, deep operational expertise, and a flexible, entrepreneurial mindset.

Ben Rafter, CEO of Springboard Hospitality, is the new chief executive officer of the combined company. Brad Rahinsky, former president and CEO of Hotel Equities, will assume the role of chairman. 

“This next chapter for the combined company establishes scale with expanded regional insight and entrepreneurial agility to support owners across every asset class,” said Brad Rahinsky, chairman of Hotel Equities. Ben Rafter, CEO of Hotel Equities, added, “We start with what both companies do best: revenue generation and technology innovation. We’ve earned our reputation by unlocking new revenue opportunities, embracing technology to stay ahead of the curve, and tailoring creative solutions for each asset. From there our combined expertise allows us to move faster, think more creatively, and deliver long-term value in ways that legacy operators simply can’t.”

Al Smith, Hotel Equities’ president of hotel operations, will assume the newly created role of chief operating officer, and Rob Robinson, executive vice president of Springboard Hospitality, will transition to the role of president of Springboard Hospitality.

Hotel Equities’ operational excellence, scaled purchasing power, and expansive North American footprint—combined with Springboard’s entrepreneurial roots and strengths in commercial strategy, technology leadership, and deep expertise in West Coast and Hawaii markets—creates a powerful hospitality platform. This next chapter establishes meaningful scale with expanded regional insight and entrepreneurial agility.

A full suite of services—including operations, revenue management, marketing, food and beverage strategy, capital planning, and development—supported by dedicated teams and a strong track record in both branded and independent environments is offered. Additional announcements, including key hires and expanded services, will be shared in the coming months as the company builds toward its next phase of growth.

 4800 North Point Parkway, Suite 250 Alpharetta, GA 30022 United States info@hotelequities.com

# Hotel Equities bolsters leadership team with slew of executive appointments 

The strategic changes across the company’s full-service, focused-service and lifestyle divisions are designed to drive platform growth and innovation.

 Published Nov. 12, 2025 

 Lara Ewen Contributor 

 

 Hotel Equities named David Rosenberg president of the focused-service division. Rosenberg previously led the company’s outdoor hospitality push by helping to integrate Postcard Cabins into the portfolio. Courtesy of Marriott International 

Hotel Equities made multiple executive appointments into newly created positions across its full-service, focused-service and lifestyle divisions, according to a news release obtained by Hotel Dive.

The internal changes will help to enhance the company’s innovation and performance initiatives, the Atlanta-based hotel operator and developer said, as well as shape guest experiences across the portfolio.

“These executives bring exceptional talent and diverse industry experience to their newly created roles,” Hotel Equities CEO Albert Smith said in the release, adding that the team’s leadership will play a critical role as the company strengthens its divisions across the U.S., Canada and the Caribbean and Latin America region.

“By promoting from within, we’re investing in high performers who will help us grow our portfolio and expand our platform for innovation — from traditional hotels to new concepts like our leading outdoor hospitality brand, Postcard Cabins,” Smith said.

Among the transitions, Hotel Equities’ Peter Tziahanas was named president of the full-service division, and David Rosenberg was named president of the focused-service division. 

Tziahanas joined Hotel Equities in 2021 and previously served as executive vice president of operations. His new role will focus on internal and external stakeholder collaboration and driving “operational excellence, profitability, and enhanced guest and employee engagement,” per the release. Prior to joining Hotel Equities, Tziahanas held leadership roles at Pivot Hotels and Resorts, HRI Lodging’s Holston House and Atrium Hospitality, according to his LinkedIn.

Rosenberg joined Hotel Equities in 2020 and was most recently the company’s executive vice president of operations. He led the company’s outdoor hospitality push by helping to integrate Postcard Cabins into the portfolio, per the release. Last December, Hotel Equities was selected to operate 29 Postcard Cabins locations, following Marriott International’s acquisition of the brand. 

Meanwhile, Liz Flurry, who joined the company in September, according to her LinkedIn, was promoted to vice president of growth marketing from her previous role as director of marketing and brand activation. She previously held leadership roles at Greenwood Hospitality and Marriott.

In the lifestyle division, Brandon Standerfer was promoted to vice president of distribution, while Jennifer Cannistraci was promoted to vice president of sales. Both executives came to Hotel Equities as part of its May merger with Springboard Hospitality, per their LinkedIn profiles.

The company also made several title changes for recent hires.

Becky Vealey’s title was updated from vice president of revenue generation to senior vice president of sales, full-service and lifestyle division. Carol Lobaito, formerly vice president of sales and marketing, is now senior vice president of sales in the focused-service division. Both Vealey and Lobaito joined the company this month.

Hotel Equities also hired Eve Tronson as vice president of marketing for its lifestyle division. She previously served in various leadership roles at Viceroy Hotels & Resorts, per the release.

Earlier this year, Hotel Equities named industry veteran Greg O’Stean as chief development officer.

Martino Enan has been appointed as chief commercial officer at Auberge Collection. Rosenberg has been promoted to president, focused service division, at Hotel Equities. Tziahanas has been promoted to president, full service division, at Hotel Equities. Tziahanas joined Hotel Equities in 2021 and previously served as executive vice president of operations, overseeing key lifestyle and owned assets across the firm’s portfolio.

Vanderlaan has been appointed as a vice president of finance at CoralTree Hospitality. She previously served as director of resort operations development and programming for Holiday Inn Club Vacations, where she led project planning and execution for new resort openings, drove technology integrations and enhanced operational performance to elevate the guest experience.

Whitefox has been appointed as a vice president of finance at CoralTree Hospitality. Most recently, he supported 16 hotels and 19 restaurants as regional director of operations finance at Sage Hospitality, where he enhanced reporting systems, improved forecast accuracy and drove cost efficiencies across a diverse portfolio.

## Ingrid Chaves

Chaves has been appointed as general manager of the Sheraton New Orleans Hotel in New Orleans. Most recently, she served as hotel manager at Orlando World Center Marriott, achieving record-breaking results in guest satisfaction and revenue growth while advancing community impact initiatives.

## Grant Friedman

Friedman has been appointed as general manager of Palm House in Palm Beach, Florida. Throughout his career, he has held senior management roles with globally recognized brands including Four Seasons, St. Regis, Ritz-Carlton, Acqualina Resort & Residences, and Wymara Resort + Villas in Turks & Caicos, where he served as opening managing director for over a decade. Most recently, he consulted with Kaleidoscope Hospitality on the forthcoming Whitfield Hotel in Fort Lauderdale, guiding the project’s pre-opening strategy, operational design and positioning within the South Florida luxury market.

## Kalyana Krishnamoorthy

Krishnamoorthy has been appointed as general manager of The Elmore Hotel, Tribute Portfolio in Southlake, Texas. Over the past 25 years, he has served in leadership roles at some of the world’s most prestigious hotel brands, including The Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis, The Luxury Collection and Four Seasons. His career has taken him to iconic destinations across the United States — Napa, Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, South Beach, and Fort Lauderdale — as well as internationally, with notable experience in countries such as Qatar, Malaysia and Singapore.

## Emily Nichols

Nichols has been appointed as general manager of The Kimpton Sawyer Hotel in Sacramento, California. Nichols most recently served in roles in the Bay Area, including the Kimpton Alton Hotel in San Francisco’s iconic Fisherman’s Wharf, where she led the team for four years and fostered Kimpton’s unique style of genuine, heartfelt hospitality. Her time in the Bay Area also included leadership roles at The Kimpton Buchanan and the historic Sir Francis Drake Hotel.

Rogers has been appointed as market general manager of The Ritz-Carlton, Naples and The Ritz-Carlton Naples, Tiburon in Naples, Florida. There, he led the Forbes Five-Star property to achieve benchmark performance in the U.S. East region.

Suer has been appointed as general manager of the Waldorf Astoria Atlanta Buckhead in Atlanta. Suer brings over 20 years of international leadership experience, having led luxury hotels and resorts across three continents under brands such as Waldorf Astoria Hotels & Resorts, IHG Hotels & Resorts and Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts. His appointment marks a return to Atlanta, where he previously held a leadership role with IHG.

## Heather Eubank

Eubank has been appointed as director of events of the Hyatt Regency Coconut Point Resort & Spa in Bonita Springs, Florida. Eubank brings 35 years of hospitality experience to her new role, having started her career at Amelia Island where she planned and executed special events and themed parties. Over nearly three decades with Hyatt Hotels Corp., she has held various event leadership roles across the brand, establishing herself as a trusted partner to both her colleagues and clients.

## Farzanah Johnson

Johnson has been appointed as director of national sales for the Northeast region of The Broadmoor in Colorado Springs, Colorado. She most recently served as northeast director of national accounts at Nemacolin Resort, where she consistently exceeded annual sales goals and significantly expanded market share.

## Luis Garcia

Garcia has been appointed as director of food and beverage of The St. Regis Bal Harbour Resort in Miami. Most recently, he served as executive director of food and beverage at SLS South Beach, where he led eight venues including The Bazaar by José Andrés and Katsuya, driving double-digit profitability gains and securing top TripAdvisor rankings for fine dining in Miami Beach.

## Dominic Gerardi

Gerardi has been appointed as director of food and beverage of the Seacliff Inn in Aptos, California. Throughout his career of more than 30 years, he has overseen multi-unit operations and large-scale staff, with a focus on cost control, vendor management and service-driven training.

## Jacopo Nardini

Nardini has been appointed as director of food and beverage of The Ritz-Carlton Dallas, Las Colinas in Irving, Texas. Most recently, Nardini served as director of restaurants at The Ritz-Carlton Half Moon Bay, where he oversaw multiple outlets and led the resort through major renovations while maintaining exceptional guest experiences and financial performance.

## Mary O'Neill

O'Neill has been appointed as executive chef of the Hilton Santa Barbara Beachfront Resort in Santa Barbara, California. A tenured Hilton leader, O’Neill most recently served as executive chef at Parc 55 Hotel by Hilton in San Francisco, overseeing all culinary operations for the 1,000-room property, including banquets, catering and restaurant outlets.

## Aki Robertson

Robertson has been appointed as executive chef of the Hyatt Regency Washington on Capitol Hill in Washington, D.C. In 2021, he was promoted to executive chef at Hyatt Regency Chesapeake Bay where he furthered his craft of creating seafood dishes inspired by the Eastern Shore.

## Liz Wolferman

Wolferman has been appointed as director of food and beverage of the Hyatt Lodge Oak Brook Chicago in Oak Brook, Illinois. Wolferman joins the hotel with 18 years of hospitality and restaurant leadership experience across Brooklyn, Portland, London and Chicago. Most recently, she served as assistant director of operations with Levy Restaurants.

## John Borras

Borras has been appointed executive chef at the Hyatt Lodge Oak Brook Chicago in Oak Brook, Illinois. He brings with him decades of culinary and operational experience through leadership roles with Marriott International properties as well as his own concept, Macarena Tapas, that he operated in Naperville for 19 years.

## Lanikai Lindsey

Lindsey has been appointed as resort manager at the Sensei Lanai, A Four Seasons Resort in Lanai City, Hawaii. He comes to the award-winning wellness retreat most recently from his position as resort manager at Four Seasons Resort Maui at Wailea. But this isn’t his first exposure to Lanai; he helped open the Lodge at Koele nearly two decades ago as part of the original Four Seasons rebranding team.

## Bertrand Mangeot

Mangeot has been appointed as managing director of the Salamander Washington DC in Washington, D.C. He joins Salamander from InterContinental San Diego, where he served as general manager since 2023.
